recordingStorage.title: Recording naming & retention
recordingStorage.subtitle: Filename templates for recordings and snapshots, per-app variables, and how long VODs are kept.
recordingStorage.loadError: Could not load the recording config.
recordingStorage.noBucket: No storage bucket is configured — recordings can't be uploaded and starting a recording will fail.

filenameTemplate.label: Recording filename template
filenameTemplate.hint: Empty = built-in naming. Applies to the local file and the S3 key. Include a time token for uniqueness.

snapshotTemplate.label: Snapshot filename template
snapshotTemplate.hint: Empty = built-in naming. Names the recording thumbnail (${type} = jpg).

recordingStorage.tokens: Tokens: ${app} ${streamId} ${room} ${type} ${ts} ${date:yyyy-MM-dd} ${var.NAME}. Rendered to one safe filename segment (no folders / path traversal).

retention.label: VOD retention
retention.hint: Delete VODs older than this from both the database and S3 storage. Off = keep forever.

variables.label: Variables
variables.hint: Plain key/value config used in filename templates as ${var.NAME}. Keys must be letters, digits or underscore. These are NOT secrets — use storage credentials for secrets.

recordingStorage.saveError: Could not save the recording config.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.subtitle: Renders this app's dashboard timestamps (logs, streams, VODs, backups…) in a fixed timezone instead of each operator's own local time. It's also the DEFAULT for any plugin/schedule that leaves its own timezone empty (an explicit plugin-level timezone always wins).
timezone.label: App timezone
timezone.hint: Search an IANA timezone name (e.g. America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires). Empty = server/host local time.
timezone.invalid: Not a recognized IANA timezone name.
timezone.serverDefault: No override set — dashboard timestamps for this app use the server/host's local time.

system.title: System
system.subtitle: API/room tokens, integrations (callbacks, storage, email) and logs for this app.

presets.title: Config presets
presets.subtitle: Apply a delivery/quality profile in one click: it backs up config.yaml, writes it and hot-reloads. It never overwrites S3 credentials or secrets.
presets.confirm: Apply the "{{title}}" preset to {{app}}? The current config.yaml is backed up first and the app is hot-reloaded. Continue?
presets.confirmDeactivate: Deactivate the "{{title}}" preset on {{app}}? Its keys are reverted to the server's factory defaults (the current config.yaml is backed up first and the app is hot-reloaded). Continue?
presets.deactivateHint: Deactivating reverts these keys to the server's factory defaults, not necessarily whatever they held before the preset was applied. For the exact prior state, use the Backups tab.

result.noChange: The config already matched the preset — nothing changed.

deactivateResult.noChange: The config was already at the factory defaults — nothing changed.

transcoding.title: Transcoding configuration
transcoding.subtitle: Adaptive delivery (simulcast) and the rendition ladder.
transcoding.shortcutNote: These controls are shortcuts: saving writes them into the app's config.yaml. The raw YAML editor under "Advanced" is the source of truth — both edit the same file.
transcoding.saveTooltip: Writes these transcoding settings into the app's config.yaml (does not touch the raw editor's unsaved text).
transcoding.saveHint: Saves the transcoding settings above to config.yaml.
transcoding.adaptiveHint: Enables multiple quality layers for the WebRTC player.
transcoding.rtmpTranscodeHint: Converts the RTMP ingress into a multi-layer ladder.
transcoding.gpuSubtitle: Encoder that FFmpeg uses to transcode.
transcoding.hwaccelHintAvailable: Auto picks GPU when it makes sense; GPU forces hardware; CPU forces software.
transcoding.hwaccelHintUnavailable: No GPU on this server: GPU and Auto automatically fall back to CPU (software).
transcoding.noLayers: No layers defined. The server will use its default ladder.

passthrough.label: RTMP → HLS passthrough (remux, no transcode)
passthrough.hint: Remux the RTMP push straight to HLS (ffmpeg -c copy), bypassing LiveKit. Near-zero CPU, no GPU. Mutually exclusive with transcoding/adaptive — turning it on disables them.
passthrough.warningTitle: Passthrough gives up (media never enters LiveKit):

lost.webrtc: No WebRTC / sub-second playback — HLS only.
lost.abr: No adaptive bitrate (ABR) — a single rendition.
lost.h264: No transcode safety net — the source MUST be H.264/AAC.
lost.room: No room features (viewer count, chat, reactions, moderation).

passthrough.serverNote: Passthrough ingest also needs STREAMHUB_RTMP_PASSTHROUGH_ENABLE on the server and port :1937 open. Without it, creating a passthrough ingress returns 503.
passthrough.transcodeDisabledNote: Passthrough is on — transcoding/adaptive are disabled. Turn passthrough off to edit them.
passthrough.disabled503: RTMP passthrough is disabled on this server. Enable STREAMHUB_RTMP_PASSTHROUGH_ENABLE and open port :1937.

raw.title: config.yaml (raw)
raw.subtitle: Edit this app's full YAML. On save it is validated (parse + shape) and hot-reloaded in memory without restarting the process or cutting other streams.
raw.sourceOfTruthNote: This raw YAML is the source of truth. The structured controls above are shortcuts that read from and write to this same file.
raw.reloadTooltip: Manual hot-reload of this app (does not restart the process)
raw.restartTooltip: Restarts the streamhub-core process (affects all apps)
raw.restartServerHint: Restarts the whole streamhub-core process. Cuts the live streams of every app.
raw.restartSuccess: Restart requested. The server may take a few seconds to come back.
raw.dryRunTooltip: Validates the YAML and shows the diff vs the live config, without writing anything
raw.saveTooltip: Writes this YAML to config.yaml and hot-reloads it (this app only, no process restart).

dryRun.validWithDiff: Valid YAML. Review the diff before saving — nothing has been written yet.
dryRun.validNoDiff: Valid YAML. No changes compared to the live config.
dryRun.invalid: Invalid YAML. Fix the errors before saving.

restartDialog.title: Restart the whole server?
restartDialog.body: This restarts the streamhub-core process (systemd). It is not the same as "Restart app" — it does not just reload this app.
restartDialog.warning: The live streams and connections of EVERY app on this server are cut for a few seconds. Only do this if you know why.
restartDialog.ack: I understand this interrupts the live streams of every app on the server.

backups.confirmRestore: Revert the config.yaml of "{{app}}" to backup {{ts}}. A backup of the current state is taken before overwriting, and it is hot-reloaded. Continue?
backups.title: config.yaml backups
backups.subtitle: Every save leaves a timestamped backup. Review it and revert if something went wrong.
backups.empty: No backups yet (they are created when you save the config).
